SELECT s.id AS supplier_id, s.code AS supplier_code, s.name AS supplier_name, s.level, COALESCE(o.order_count, 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(t.purchase_amount, 0) AS purchase_amount, COALESCE(t.in_lines, 0) AS in_lines, COALESCE(t.on_time_lines, 0) AS on_time_lines, COALESCE(t.in_qty, 0) AS in_qty, COALESCE(t.return_qty, 0) AS return_qty, e.total_score AS last_score, e.grade AS last_grade, e.period AS last_period FROM scm_supplier s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT partner_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM scm_order WHERE kind = 'PURCHASE' AND status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVING') AND order_date >= #{begin} AND order_date <= #{end} GROUP BY partner_id ) o ON o.partner_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.partner_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'PURCHASE_IN' THEN i.amount ELSE -i.amount END) AS purchase_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'PURCHASE_IN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'PURCHASE_IN' AND (oi.delivery_date IS NULL OR d.biz_date <= oi.delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'PURCHASE_IN' THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END) AS in_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'PURCHASE_RETURN' THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END) AS return_qty FROM scm_trade_doc d JOIN scm_trade_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id JOIN scm_order_item oi ON oi.id = i.order_item_id WHERE d.kind IN ('PURCHASE_IN', 'PURCHASE_RETURN') AND d.biz_date >= #{begin} AND d.biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY d.partner_id ) t ON t.partner_id = s.id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier_eval e ON e.id = (SELECT MAX(e2.id) FROM scm_supplier_eval e2 WHERE e2.supplier_id = s.id)
s.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY purchase_amount DESC, s.code
